I really wanted to like this game and granted I should probably should've given it more time but this game just feels off. The progression seems to match the pace of the game but in the worst way possible; it almost feels like I'm not making any progress on my build strength regardless of my weapons or levels. Something I can commend however is the characters, their abilities, and the game concept of learning more about them the more you play. But ultimately I didn't find this game to hit the same way as any of FromSoftware's other games, which makes sense given it's trying something completely different but regardless, it just feels off.

At first, I was very skeptical of the concept of Elden Ring Nightreign, but once I got my hands on this and started my first few expeditions, this game really rekindled my flame for souls-likes and I found myself deeply immersed in my own desires to learn this game and master it as much as I could. With the addition of a mode for duos, it has been nothing but fun playing this game with my partner and facing the Night together.
Coupled with the bits of lore scattered about for all of the Nightfarers, this game really did tickle all the parts of my brain that are just so rotted with my obsession with souls-likes and not only that, it felt really rewarding using my knowledge of some enemies' weakness from Elden Ring so it was just the cherry on top of this wonderful experience.

While Elden Ring base game was a grand adventure where you slowly explored the world of the lands between, Nightreign is for those who wish it was more easily replayable in short casual sessions. Jump in, find a weapon, and kill some bosses with your teammates. 

Even though map randomization is not as extensive as I would like, there is a satisfaction in mastering the map and flowing between camps and field bosses. Randomized weapons make builds varied, the different classes offer significantly different playing styles, and some (not all) of the new Nightlords are very fun and engaging.

Not a perfect game, but an addicting gameplay loop for those who just want to play some more Elden Ring. Well worth the price it goes for.

Amazingly fun game, you can play against new nightlord bosses with cool attack patterns and the pre-existing bosses throughout the map. It's got all the good gameplay of elden ring with modernised UI and simpler scaling logic (with no requirements on weapons to use etc.)

Each nightfarer is unique in their own ways and if you play each one for a while you will realise each one is super fun and have their own naunces and higher skill ceilings than on first glance.

The difficulty of the game takes a bit to get used to, but once you get used to the time constraints it gets pretty easy if you keep going for easier nightlords. The everdark bosses and deep of night allow you to have more to work towards once you get better and better at the game.

It's extremely rewarding to play solo or while you carry your teammates. 10/10 I hope I never stop playing this game :D

If it weren't for Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, this would be my game of the year. This was Nightreign summer for me. It's such a blast to play with friends - if you're a fan of the Souls games and have a couple of friends to play with, you cannot go wrong with this game. It's much more fast paced than Elden Ring or any of the Souls games, but it's that gameplay that makes every decision critical in a way that feels rewarding when it pays off. The collaboration between teammates is a lot of fun and the celebration of defeating a boss is so much fun to share with friends. There's a learning curve, but once you get into a flow, it's a ton of fun moving at lightspeed. Highly recommend this game. 10/10

It's easy to recommend Nightreign, but the reward structure is bad. Every run, successful or otherwise, grants you relics to run different builds in future runs. These rewards are plainly not enough. I guess I burnt myself out with all the Everdark bosses and Deep of Night content before the DLC. Which is fine. I still recommend the game. It's a great Souls co-op made only better on discord with comms. I maintain that solo is not well iterated, and I abhor solo: Nightreign was simply design around three player co-op. But this is not a negative review. Half the fun of the game is finding those outrageous builds that overpower content, but they have an achilles heel, annnnnd back to the initial point, the game does not reward you with enough relics to try too many new builds. Still an easy game to recommend. The characters are strong and unique, lots of balance has been done, and you cannot go wrong with this game. My complaints are end game community types of complaints. This game reminds me of Elden Ring with an X-men like cast of characters. Highly recommend!
